giftDescription: Offer {give} to {person}. Nothing moves unless they accept within {minutes} game minutes; I keep it meanwhile and can withdraw it.
title: Trade
changed: The terms changed. Review both sides before replying.
reciprocalUnavailable: The agreed items are no longer available.
giftUnavailable: The offered items are no longer available.
choosePerson: Choose a person you can currently see.
recipientLocation: Nearby person, offer requires their acceptance
recipientUnavailable: Wait until you can use your inventory to choose a recipient.
recipientSourceChanged: The selected item or its source changed. Refresh before choosing a destination.
cannotTake: That person cannot take items now.
offerReach: Move within arm's reach of that person.
mutualSight: You and the offerer must be able to see each other.
acceptReach: Move within arm's reach of the offerer to take it.
reviewItem: An item changed. Review the current offer.
notPortable: This object cannot be handed over.
quantity: You do not have that many free to offer.
accessGranted: Clear this bag's access list before offering it.
duplicateItem: Choose each item or containing object only once.
alreadyOffered: These items are already being offered.
unavailable: These offer terms are no longer available.
ownEnding: You ended your own participation in the last received offer. No other person’s current choice is reported.
ownEndingReceipt: Your remembered offer participation ended; nothing moved.
witnessExchange: {verb} an item exchange with someone nearby.
deadline: The stated offer deadline has passed.
lapsed: Your previously offered terms are no longer available.
proposed: Offered {terms}. Nothing moves unless they accept within {minutes} game minutes; you can withdraw it.
whole: This object must be offered whole.
selectionHint: Search or page through your belongings and the items this person has offered you. Their items and amounts may have changed.
remembered: Last disclosed; current availability is unknown.
unknown: No item has been disclosed. They can offer an item first.
replyAcceptGift: Accept {person}'s gift of {terms}. Receive it into my possession now.
replyDeclineGift: Decline {person}'s offer of {terms}. Close this proposal; receive nothing and transfer nothing.
replyAcceptTrade: Receive {receive} and give {give}; both move together or neither.
replyDeclineTrade: Decline {person}'s offer of {terms}. Close this proposal while keeping my {give}; receive nothing and transfer nothing.
rememberedOfferDescription: Last known offer. No possessions move until a separately admitted acceptance. Current availability is checked when you attempt it.
replyDuringWork: Replying does not interrupt unrelated work.
decision: Choose freely using the exact items, your current needs, possessions and goals. Declining is a valid choice. No item moves before acceptance.
draftChanged: The offer changed or ended. Keep your draft and review the current terms, or submit a new offer.
